items.text: General layer toolbar (C4) — Essentials, Advanced, and Show all sit in one segmented row at the top of the fused General surface; legacy Advanced section-jump nav removed.
Button visibility rows — General → Bookmarks → Button visibility uses divided list rows instead of a nested table card.
Active tab styling (C2) — stronger highlight on the active tab group label and selected tab so the current location is easier to see on Classic, Modern, and Glass.
List-tab shell (A2) — Pages, Categories, Tags, Finders, and Collections share config-list-tab markup and config-tab-intro intro copy.
Stats split-layout (B10) — chip navigation and sidebar index move inside the fused Stats surface (same split-shell pattern as Help).
Bookmarks master/detail (B11) — filters and bulk actions sit above a split view: bookmark list (master pane) + detail editor (detail pane) inside one fused surface.

Theme colors divided list (C11) — color rows, custom themes list, page selector, and live preview use divided-list rhythm inside the fused Theme surface — no nested cards on Modern, Glass, or Classic.
README, MANUAL, Config Help & What's new — release notes for v2026.07.04; Help recap and config-tab help sections updated (EN/NL/DE/FR).
Playwright — config tab consistency tests for Stats split shell, Bookmarks master/detail, and Theme divided-list rhythm.
Cache-bust — whats-new-v126 data version; theme-colors-divided-c11-1, bookmarks-master-b11-1, stats-split-b10-1, config-tab-active-c2-1, and config-polish-c4-1 on config CSS bundles.
